items.existing_proposition: Inference memory budget 是 Part V 所有机制的共同约束。Weights 决定固定底座，KV 决定随请求增长的容量，workspace 与 communication 决定瞬时峰值，fragmentation 和 reserve 决定逻辑公式与实际可分配空间的差距。

items.title: POLAR: Online Learning for LoRA Adapter Caching and Routing in Edge LLM Serving
items.existing_proposition: - Orca, iteration-level scheduling: https://www.usenix.org/conference/osdi22/presentation/yu - PagedAttention / vLLM: https://arxiv.org/abs/2309.06180 - SGLang / RadixAttention: https://arxiv.org/abs/2312.07104 - Speculative Decoding: https://arxiv.org/abs/2211.17192 - DistServe / goodput 与 PD resource allocation: https://arxiv.org/abs/2401.09670 - Mooncake / SLO-aware KV-centric scheduling: https://arxiv.org/abs/2407.00079 - Online Scheduling for LLM Inference with KV Cache Constraints: https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.07115 - s1: Simple test-time scaling（reasoning-budget bounded case）: https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.19393 - "AIConfigurator: Lightning-Fast Configuration Optimization for Multi-Framewo
items.evidence_delta: 作者公开的机制是：Serving a request through a non-resident adapter requires paging its weights from storage, incurring measurable latency. This creates a two-timescale online control problem: on a slow timescale, the system selects which adapters remain resident in fast memory, while on a fast timescale it routes each request to an adapter whose context-dependent utility is unknown a priori. 对系统而言，控制权落在 admission、runtime execution、resource scheduling 与 SLO observation。
items.claim_boundary: `POLAR: Online Learning for LoRA Adapter Caching and Routing in Edge LLM Serving` 只证明 exact-v1 的公开模型、数据、硬件和 workload；evaluation evidence 为：An epoch-doubling version, POLAR+, adds forced exploration and improved cache optimization to achieve $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(d\sqrt{NT}+\sqrt{KT})$ sublinear regret under stochastic regularity and cacheability conditions, where $N$ is the adapter count, $K$ the cache size, $d$ the context dimension, and $T$ the horizon. Experiments using 15 real LoRA adapters for Qwen2.5-7B together with measured GPU paging latencies show that adaptive cache control substantially outperforms non-adaptive baselines and exhibits scaling trends consistent with the theory. 未披露生产 SLO、多租户、跨硬件或长期运行结果时，不得外推。
items.changed_constraint: 旧路径以单模型、固定 batch 或静态资源配置换取可预测性；异构 workload、SLO 与资源压力变化后，局部吞吐不等于端到端服务效率。 论文暴露的具体压力是：Edge deployment of large language models (LLMs) increasingly relies on libraries of lightweight LoRA adapters, yet GPU/DRAM can keep only a small resident subset at a time.
items.state_control_owner: 作者公开的机制是：Serving a request through a non-resident adapter requires paging its weights from storage, incurring measurable latency. This creates a two-timescale online control problem: on a slow timescale, the system selects which adapters remain resident in fast memory, while on a fast timescale it routes each request to an adapter whose context-dependent utility is unknown a priori. 对系统而言，控制权落在 admission、runtime execution、resource scheduling 与 SLO observation。

items.evidence_delta: 作者公开的机制是：To address this problem we introduce ReconVLA, a reliable conformal model that produces uncertainty-guided and failure-aware control signals. 对系统而言，控制权落在 observation/state/action transition 与 physical feedback。
items.claim_boundary: `ReconVLA: An Uncertainty-Guided and Failure-Aware Vision-Language-Action Framework for Robotic Control` 只证明 exact-v1 的公开模型、数据、硬件和 workload；evaluation evidence 为：We evaluate ReconVLA in both simulation and real robot experiments across diverse manipulation tasks. Our results show that conformalized action predictions consistently improve failure anticipation, reduce catastrophic errors, and provide a calibrated measure of confidence without retraining or modifying the underlying VLA. 未披露生产 SLO、多租户、跨硬件或长期运行结果时，不得外推。
